chapter: Rising in Manhattan: clubs, Hilda and the Latin scene
title: Diosa Costello and Jack Robbins open doors
summary: Diosa Costello brought publisher Jack Robbins, who introduced them to manager Jack Leer, and she recommended them to the Chateau Madrid.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Okay. Macho, who was some of the bands that worked opposite you at the Park Plaza for the time that you worked there?
Well, Orquesta Siboney, ahh, Augusto Coen, Noro Morales - few times - and then, Diosa Costelo. She is responsible for whatever we have now.
One day, Jack Robbins, that was the president of three famous names: Robbins, Faith and.......

Yes. He was a music lover and he liked to dance-Latin music, Cuban music, and Diosa Costelo was a top name in that particular time like Chita Rivera or the other girl; and she was working all over the place so he heard about Machito because she used to live in the barrio too.
She heard about us and Jack Robbins was trying to make a Spanish or Latin catalogue because he had in mind that

this is going to be something big so he got together with Mario, by accident, and he introduced us to Jack Leer and Jack Leer became our personal manager and he got us a few things. So then one day we worked - Diosa Costelo recommend us to Lopez, the owner of the Chateau Madrid, "There was a band in the barrio, tremendous", blah, blah, blah, but Lopez was hesitant about us because he didn't know us.
